# Unchanged public ONVIF source inputs

The authoritative URL, SHA-256, size, namespace, per-file schema version,
import resolution, and redistribution record is
[`bindings\onvif\sources.lock.json`](../../bindings/onvif/sources.lock.json).
`specs\` preserves selected paths from ONVIF commit
`68ee1b540a40f848c9599eba2c55b87547c588d6`; `external\` contains separately
pinned dependency documents. Original bytes, embedded notices, and line endings
are unchanged. `notices\` contains complete original license documents.

Preserve the source lock and required notice files with any redistribution,
including the source-specific attribution recorded for W3C documents without
embedded notices. Use the offline `--export` command documented in
[`spec\onvif-sources.md`](../../spec/onvif-sources.md) to copy a source/dependency/
notice closure and its provenance together. Copying isolated schemas can omit
required notices or dependencies.

The ONVIF repository `LICENSE.md` is a Contributor License Agreement, not a
blanket Apache license for specifications. No license is assigned here to
project-authored code. Unchanged-copy permission does not establish patent,
branding, profile-symbol, certification, or generated-derivative clearance.

Profile PDFs are URL/hash references, not bundled documents. April 2005
WS-Discovery and August 2004 WS-Addressing remain **fetch-only** because their
embedded distribution-purpose restrictions need review for the intended package
distribution. They are not silently replaced by newer protocols. No private ACF,
member-only ONVIF document, or camera-derived content is present here.
